articles.summary: Entravision (NYSE: EVC), a media and advertising technology company, announced today that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results after market close on Thursday, November 5, 2026 . The company will host a webinar to discuss its results followed by a question-and-answer session at 2 p.m. PT/ 5 p.m. ET the same day. The webinar may be accessed on the company’s Investor Relations website at investor.entravision.com or via webinar registration . The webinar will also be archived on
articles.title: Entravision to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

articles.summary: Fehmi Zeko and Gilbert Vasquez to leave the Board Entravision Communications Corporation (NYSE: EVC) announced that Brian Krzanich and Gary Ferrera have joined its Board of Directors, effective October 14, 2026. Mr. Ferrera also joins the Board's Audit Committee. Mr. Krzanich brings technology and AI experience to the Board. He spent 36 years at Intel, including five as Chief Executive Officer. articles.title: Entravision Appoints Brian Krzanich and Gary Ferrera to Board of Directors
